findings.text: The company has status 'active' and was incorporated on 27 October 2014.
No insolvency record is held for the company.
Accounts are not overdue, with the next due date being 30 September 2027, and the confirmation statement is not overdue, with the next due date being 6 April 2027.
There have been 3 officer appointments and 1 resignation since 24 October 2025.
There are 3 outstanding charges registered against the company.
The current directors are linked to 57 other companies, of which 23 are dissolved.
There is 1 current person with significant control, who owns between 25 and 50 percent of shares.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 532 is active with no insolvency records, but has recent officer changes, outstanding charges, and directors linked to dissolved companies.
